36.name: Block Board
36.description: Block Boards are high-strength wood panels made with solid wood strips as the core, laminated with veneers under high pressure.<br data-start="569" data-end="572" />They are widely used in furniture manufacturing, interior decoration, doors, partitions, and wall cladding due to their stability and excellent screw-holding capacity.<br data-start="739" data-end="742" />Our block boards are crafted with eco-friendly adhesives and selected hardwood, ensuring flat surfaces, durability, and resistance to warping.<br data-start="884" data-end="887" />With strict quality inspection and sustainable production, Shouguang Bailing Wood Industry provides reliable and green decorative materials for global customers.

35.name: Cement Board
35.description: Cement Boards are high-strength building panels made from cement and reinforced fibers, cured under high pressure and temperature.<br data-start="571" data-end="574" />They feature excellent fire resistance, moisture resistance, mold protection, and impact strength, ideal for interior and exterior walls, ceilings, floors, and partitions.<br data-start="745" data-end="748" />With a dense and stable structure, cement boards provide a reliable base for tiles, paints, or stone finishes.<br data-start="858" data-end="861" />Produced with advanced technology and strict quality control, Shouguang Bailing ensures every board meets international construction and environmental standards.

39.name: Door
39.description:
Our craftsmen skillfully craft our Door Series from premium materials and apply eco-friendly finishes, elegantly combining durability with functionality.
We offer a diverse range including solid wood doors, composite doors, molded doors, and eco doors, making them ideal for homes, apartments, offices, and commercial spaces.

38.name: Door Skin
38.description: Door Skins are decorative surface panels used for enhancing and protecting wooden doors.<br data-start="532" data-end="535" />Made from high-quality MDF or HDF with PVC, melamine, or wood grain finishes, our door skins feature realistic textures, rich colors, and superior durability.<br data-start="693" data-end="696" />They provide excellent moisture resistance, wear resistance, and anti-cracking performance, suitable for molded doors, composite doors, and interior door applications.<br data-start="863" data-end="866" />Shouguang Bailing offers a wide range of designs and customization options to meet diverse market and aesthetic demands.

40.name: Edge Banding
40.description: Edge Banding is used to seal and protect furniture panel edges for a clean, durable finish.<br data-start="415" data-end="418" />Made from PVC or ABS, it offers strong adhesion, moisture resistance, and various colors and textures.

41.name: Film Faced Plywood
41.description: Film Faced Plywood is made from high-quality hardwood core with waterproof glue and a phenolic film coating.<br data-start="464" data-end="467" />It offers excellent strength, water resistance, and smooth surface, ideal for concrete formwork and construction projects.

34.name: Gypsum Board
34.description: Gypsum Board is a lightweight building material made with a gypsum core and paper surfaces.<br data-start="399" data-end="402" />It offers fire resistance, sound insulation, and smooth finishing for walls, ceilings, and partitions.

37.name: Hard Board
37.description: Hard Board is a high-density fiberboard made from refined wood fibers under heat and pressure.<br data-start="411" data-end="414" />It offers smooth surface, durability, and strength for furniture backing, doors, and decorative bases.

23.name: MDF
23.description: MDF (Medium Density Fiberboard) is made from high-quality wood fibers pressed under heat and pressure. It features a smooth surface, uniform density, and excellent machinability for furniture and decoration.

32.name: Particle Board
32.description: Particle Board is made from wood particles bonded under heat and pressure, offering a smooth surface and strong screw-holding ability. Ideal for furniture, cabinets, doors, and interior decoration.

33.name: Plywood
33.description: Plywood is made of cross-laminated wood veneers bonded with strong adhesive, offering high strength and stability. It is widely used in furniture, doors, decoration, and construction projects.

42.name: SPC Flooring
42.description: SPC Flooring is a rigid core vinyl floor made from stone powder and polymer resin. It is waterproof, wear-resistant, and easy to install, ideal for homes, offices, and commercial areas.

43.name: Wall Panel
43.description: Wall Panels are decorative panels for interior walls, made from wood, PVC, or composite materials. They are durable, moisture-resistant, and visually appealing, ideal for homes, offices, and commercial spaces

44.name: WPC Wall Panels
44.description: WPC Wall Panels are made from wood powder and PVC composite, offering waterproof, moisture-resistant, and durable properties. Ideal for interior walls, ceilings, and decorative projects, with easy installation and natural appearance.
